FINAL DEVELOPMENT EXECUTION — COMPLETE REMAINING ENGINEERING GAPS

Do not generate additional narratives, status reports, certifications, or plans.

Implement, test, deploy, and verify the following engineering work only.

P0 — DEPLOYMENT

1. Deploy Confirmation Consistency
- Fix deployment confirmation mismatch.
- Ensure GitHub HEAD, Render deployment SHA, /health, and /version always report the same production commit.
- Fail deployment if SHA parity is not achieved.

2. Senior Developer Runtime
- Implement timeout, retry, recovery, and cancellation logic.
- Prevent worker stalls or infinite execution.
- Log every execution with timestamps and final status.
- Verify uninterrupted execution under production conditions.

P1 — SENIOR DEVELOPER EXECUTION

3. Complete Git Workflow
Implement the complete production engineering workflow:

Owner approval
→ Create feature branch
→ Modify code
→ Run lint
→ Run typecheck
→ Run tests
→ Commit
→ Push
→ Open Pull Request
→ Wait for owner approval
→ Merge
→ Trigger GitHub Actions
→ Deploy to Render
→ Verify production
→ Record evidence

No manual intervention except owner approval.

4. Automated Quality Gates
- Remove skipped quality gates.
- Execute lint, typecheck, unit tests, integration tests, and build validation automatically.
- If any tool is unavailable, report the failure honestly instead of skipping validation.
- Block production deployment if required quality gates fail.

P2 — AUTONOMOUS SYSTEM

5. Scheduler Integration
Connect the scheduler directly to the autonomous developer worker.

Approved engineering tasks must automatically:
- Enter queue
- Execute
- Recover from failures
- Retry when appropriate
- Complete
- Produce execution evidence

Verify continuous autonomous operation without manual triggering.

6. End-to-End Autonomous Validation
Create one complete production integration test proving the full engineering lifecycle:

Owner request
→ Task created
→ Scheduler queues task
→ Autonomous worker executes
→ Code modified
→ Tests executed
→ Commit created
→ Branch pushed
→ Pull Request opened
→ Owner approval
→ Merge completed
→ GitHub Actions executed
→ Render deployed
→ Live /health verified
→ Live /version verified
→ SHA parity confirmed
→ Execution evidence stored

OWNER REQUIREMENTS

Perform all work only against:

GitHub:
ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

Use only my owner-controlled infrastructure.

Do not use any Rork-owned repository, fork, deployment source, branch, or production environment.

FINAL DELIVERABLE

When complete, return only:

- GitHub commit SHA
- Pull Request number
- Files modified
- Tests executed
- GitHub Actions result
- Render deployment ID
- Live /health
- Live /version
- SHA parity confirmation
- Autonomous execution evidence
- Final production certification

Do not stop until all six engineering gaps are completed, deployed, verified, and evidenced.
